entries.text: Fixed a bug where differentiating an elementwise function applied to a matrix, such as `X.applyfunc(lambda z: exp(z + 1)).diff(X)`, dropped the shift or scaling in the function argument and gave `exp(z)` instead of `exp(z + 1)`.
Fixed a bug where the derivative of `ArrayElementwiseApplyFunc` lost the argument of the differentiated function, for example giving `exp(x)` instead of `exp(x + 1)`.
